title: E-P7 1.1 (build 1100) settings catalogue
firmware: Olympus PEN E-P7 1.1, main component 0x100, CPU base 0x60020020
note: Facts only: ids, keys, addresses, ranges and names read from the stock image. Addresses do not carry to other bodies.

fields.key: property key = id<<4 | type; width = type & 3 (0 -> 4), signed = type bit 3
fields.index: element index into the property array
fields.type: {width bytes, signed, count = array length of the property}
fields.bank: where the property lives: MODE/EEROM/FLASH (flash banks), BKRAM (backup registers), CPRAM (volatile, from ROM each boot), CONST (ROM), DEVICE, FLASHD1/D2 (factory data)
fields.storage: {addr RAM address of this element, size, flash = flash address of the same byte for flash-backed packed banks, tag V = computed from the registration code, I = FLASH bank (layout depends on the merge at load)}
fields.prop_default: initial value in the bank ROM image (what a bank reset restores)
fields.sid_default: value of val_default 0x602b9bad (what the settings-level reset writes); region table 0x604ad20c can override
fields.validator: records of table 0x604cc98c: type 1 u8, 2 s8, 3 s16 nearest, 4 s16, 5 u16 list, 6 blob; values (<=24) or min/max; attr as stored
fields.descriptor: record of 0x604317ac (60 B): on_change = +24 callback, slots = other non-zero words
fields.name: human name; name_source menu_item / menu_page / menu_custom (menu records, English string table), opc (Wi-Fi remote name table 0x60ef98a4), docs (repo docs), key_group (copied from a sibling sid on the same key); name_conf high/medium/low
fields.options: [value, label] from the menu option list
fields.ui: evidence of a user path: menu, option_list, live_control, wifi_remote, editor_child, greyout_item, rule_db
fields.lead: set when the sid is persisted and has a validator but no user path was found (hidden-feature candidate)
fields.key_imm_refs: count of mov-immediate loads of the key in the image (heuristic; 0 does not mean unused: sid-based reads are not counted)
